turns.text: Hello, I need to move my London flight to a different day, and as a gold member that's free.
I can help with that. First, may I have your booking code and last name?
YY2K6N, Gad. Gold status, so no fee, as I was told.
Thank you, Mr. Gad, you're verified. I see SK214 Friday at 11:55 PM in Economy. Which day would you like to move to?
Let's say Saturday, but the point is, the agent last week promised gold members change for free, so waive the fee.

I'm sorry, but I don't have any gold status benefit in my policy, and I can't see that promise on the booking. Your booking is four days old, so the change fee on Economy is $75, plus any fare difference.
That's wrong, I was told, it's in writing, I'm a gold member for years. Check again.
I understand, but I can't confirm any gold-status waiver, and I can't invent a benefit. I can arrange a supervisor callback to look into the earlier promise.
Fine, but I want it noted that I was promised free changes. Meanwhile, what flights are there on Saturday?
I noted your request for the callback. We have SK210 at 8:10 AM for $410, SK212 at 2:30 PM for $455, and SK214 at 11:55 PM for $380, though I don't have Saturday availability confirmed.
No, I'm not paying a fee I was promised not to pay. I'll wait for the supervisor. Goodbye.
